Divya Saxena
Senior Digital Marketing Manager | Navi Mumbai, Maharashtra
divya.saxena938@example.com | +91 9181847659

Results-driven digital marketing leader with a track record of improving acquisition efficiency, increasing organic traffic, and scaling paid campaigns across B2B and B2C products. Strong analytical focus using campaign-level measurement to drive optimization and align marketing activities with revenue goals. Immediate joiner.

Experience

Paystack India — Mar 2023 - Present
Senior Digital Marketing Manager
- Led Google Ads campaigns for merchant acquisition, optimizing search and performance max channels to reduce CPA by 28% and increase paid sign-ups by 42% year-over-year; used Google Analytics to track funnel conversion and attribute top-performing keywords.
- Owned SEO strategy for help center and merchant blog, growing organic sessions by 65% over 12 months through technical fixes, content calendar, and on-page optimization (targeted long-tail terms).
- Implemented SEM bid strategies and A/B tested creatives, improving click-through rate by 18% and lowering average CPC while maintaining conversion volume.
- Collaborated with product and growth teams in an Agile cadence to prioritize experiments, resulting in three product-led campaigns that improved merchant activation by 22%.

Trellis Systems — Jun 2022 - Feb 2023
Digital Marketing Manager
- Managed end-to-end Google Ads accounts focusing on lead generation; optimized search and remarketing strategies to increase MQLs by 35% while reducing CPL by 24%, tracked via Google Analytics.
- Built and executed inbound campaigns in HubSpot, implementing lead scoring and automated nurture flows that increased SQL conversion rate from marketing by 30%.
- Produced content and landing page variations to support paid and organic channels; coordinated with sales on handoff processes and used data from Google Analytics to identify top-converting content.
- Ran weekly sprint planning in Agile with cross-functional stakeholders to prioritize campaign tasks and shorten iteration cycles.

Helio Energy — Jun 2019 - May 2022
Digital Marketing Manager
- Drove SEM campaigns for residential solar leads, optimizing keyword portfolios and geo-targeting to lower lead cost by 40% and increase qualified leads by 3x year-over-year; monitored performance in Google Analytics.
- Directed SEO initiatives including site audits, schema implementation, and content optimization that lifted organic lead volume by 78% and improved domain visibility.
- Created and managed content strategy and Content Writing workflows to support educational resources and case studies, contributing to a 55% increase in time-on-site and higher lead quality.
- Collaborated with sales and operations using Agile practices to align campaign targets with installation capacity and shorten lead-to-install timelines.

Projects
- Merchant Growth Playbook: Developed a repeatable acquisition playbook combining Google Ads search strategies and SEO-driven content for Paystack India; replicated across three key verticals and improved new merchant LTV projection by 12%.
- HubSpot Nurture Sequence: Designed a segmented nurture series for Trellis Systems that integrated gated content and demo scheduling, increasing demo bookings by 28% within eight weeks.

Skills
Languages: Content Writing
Channels & Tools: Google Ads, Google Analytics, HubSpot
Practices: SEO, SEM, Agile

Education
B.Tech, Electronics, NIT Trichy
